mentions.name: Obsetico App
mentions.description: A mobile app for tracking tasks, events, and information about anything you care about—cars, homes, tools, workshops, appliances, pets, or lab equipment. Resources can be organized in a hierarchy like folders, with tasks, pictures, geolocation, contacts, notes, and events attached to each, and resources can now be shared with others.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Obsetico App (named after a friends' comment that "it's great for Obsessed people like my wife"

A mobile app to track tasks, events and any info about anything you care about: your car, home, tools, workshop, appliances, pets, lab equipment... anything really.
